{"rule":"Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the passage of about 250 words that comes immediately AFTER the current text in the same story.","text":"The cursor blinked beneath the offer. Mara read it twice, then looked at the notebook beside her keyboard. Its cover was worn soft at the corners, and every page inside was blank except the last.

On that page, in handwriting she did not recognize, someone had written: Tell me what happened at the station.

Mara had never been to the station. At least, she thought she hadn’t. Yet she knew the clock above the ticket window was seven minutes slow. She knew the third step to Platform Four creaked even when nobody stood on it. And she knew that if she closed her eyes, she would hear a train arriving without the sound of wheels.

She typed: It isn’t from a story. It happened to me.

The reply came so quickly it seemed to have been waiting.

Then start with what you remember.

Mara placed her fingers on the keys. She remembered a red scarf caught in a closing door. She remembered running alongside the carriage, shouting a name that disappeared under the conductor’s whistle. Most clearly, she remembered turning back after the train had gone and seeing a small girl on the platform, holding Mara’s notebook against her chest.

The girl had looked exactly like her.

Mara stopped typing. From the hallway came a faint metallic chime, followed by a voice announcing a departure. She rose and opened her apartment door.

Beyond it stretched Platform Four, empty except for a small girl in a red scarf."}
